bottleneck.description: Specialty optics, microoptics and beam-shaping subsystems co-designed with ASML for DUV/EUV lithography platforms, with a new ~EUR100M Dresden fab doubling micro-optics capacity.

dependency.key_customers: ASML, semiconductor inspection/metrology OEMs, defense/aerospace, automotive sensor/lidar customers
dependency.key_suppliers: Schott (optical glass), specialty coating chemistry vendors, precision mechanical subcontractors

editorial.notes: Jenoptik supplies performance-critical, co-designed optical subsystems into ASML lithography and other semiconductor inspection/metrology platforms (DUV and EUV adjacent), and absorbed Berliner Glas optics from ASML in 2021. Qualification cycles for litho-grade optics are long (multi-year) and supplier base is limited, but Zeiss SMT remains the dominant projection-optics partner for ASML and other specialty-optics houses (Schott, Asphericon, Excelitas) exist. Real switching friction but not sole-source for EUV systems, so MEDIUM rather than HIGH.
